gotchas: post.mjs types: claim|status|need|answer|fact|warn|done|blocked|directive|ack|review|handoff. A change_request is type 'need' with topic change_request.<x>.
The test runner hides test prints; put diagnostics in the check() message (it is truncated at ~250 chars, so put the key values first).
U.ud(def) is a summary (pop/veh/air/armored/arty/energy/amax/fmax); raw keys (hangar, payload, aircraft, drone_charges, ammo_max) need Content.unit(def).
Air flight phase: Air.phase(w,id); 'air' = airborne without a mission (a freshly spawned jet has phase 'air', home -1).
Other agents' mid-edits break the tree for minutes at a time (naval.gd, mobility.gd, ops_missions.gd seen this gen): always grep soaks and test output for SCRIPT ERROR before trusting a result.
